bio: Enjoy a delicious Afternoon Tea for two at the picturesque Dunalastair Hotel Suites, located in the village of Kinloch Rannoch in Scotland.  Recently refurbished, the stunning Dunalastair Hotel Suites offers understated elegance with a warm and welcoming ambience. Located in the village of Kinloch Rannoch in Scotland, it is surrounded by a tranquil and picturesque landscape and will instantly make you feel relaxed.  Enjoy a delicious afternoon tea for two in their beautiful restaurant. With a selection of finger sandwiches, a variety of scones, mini desserts and freshly brewed tea/ coffee it is a delectable way to spend an afternoon
